test_suite.notes: 249 files passed, 3 skipped; 43 tests skipped (opt-in slow group); coverage thresholds held (exit 0). Spec tests run by name: review-numbers 6/6, decision-grades 3/3, review-panel 1/1.

end_to_end.command: Built app (npm run build && preview, as Playwright's webServer) in Chromium and WebKit at 1280x720; holdout spec plays 2 hands from New game -> Start game with two different pinned replay codes, opens Hint at decisions, acts (check/call, one bet/raise), reads the Hand Review panel and the IndexedDB hand record; also spec Judge command (review-numbers, review, bust-continue, hint, hand-records) as part of the full suite
end_to_end.expected: Each review entry shows the same advised action, chart line (preflop) or Equity/Required equity (postflop), explanation and opponent-range lines as the hint card shown at that decision; values equal the stored record's decision entries; one worker grade request per user click; no main-thread grading
end_to_end.actual: 4 runs (2 codes x 2 browsers), 19 decisions per browser (4+4, 5+6 entries; preflop entries e.g. 'From the 6-max chart: fold Q4o from the cutoff', no equity parts; postflop e.g. 'Equity 17.2%'/'Required equity 22.2%'): every hinted entry deep-equals its hint card, every entry equals the stored record (explanation, formatted equityPct/requiredEquityPct, grade label, basis texts, hinted flag true exactly where Hint was opened); grade request count went up by exactly 1 after each click; no page errors; axe clean with the panel open. With a worker wrapper that alters only grade replies (marks the explanation, sets equityPct 12.345), the panel and the stored record both show the altered values ('Equity 12.3%') in both browsers, so nothing is regraded on the main thread.
